policy: Reviewed RO UAT geometry exceptions. SIRUTA remains legal identity authority; OSM remains the default geometry source. Where OSM lacks a distinct UAT boundary or a reviewed OSM boundary materially conflicts with the official ANCPI/RELUAT UAT polygon, the exact ANCPI feature may be used as an explicit fallback representation without asserting legal-geometry equivalence.

items.review_conclusion: SIRUTA 64096 is a current legal UAT and OSM has no distinct Brețcu/Bereck boundary relation. Relation 14735731 is Ojdula (SIRUTA 64602), but its OSM polygon materially overlaps the reviewed ANCPI Brețcu polygon and must not be used to represent Brețcu. ANCPI/RELUAT nationalCode 64096 is retained as the explicit Brețcu fallback.

fallback_geometry.authority: Agenția Națională de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară

items.review_conclusion: OSM relation 14735731 is correctly reconciled to Ojdula/SIRUTA 64602, but its polygon materially overlaps the reviewed ANCPI/RELUAT Brețcu UAT polygon. Preserve the stable OSM catalog identity and legal binding, but replace only its administrative geometry representation with ANCPI/RELUAT nationalCode 64602.
